What colors are in Desert Sunrise stone panels? Desert Sunrise features a warm beige base with natural red, sand, and subtle brown tones. The color variation gives it a realistic stone appearance while remaining versatile for both indoor and outdoor applications. Kyle Reichrath Project Coordinator Where can Desert Sunrise be used? Desert Sunrise panels can be used really anywhere with a flat installation surface including: - Exterior siding and facades - Outdoor kitchens and fireplaces - Interior accent walls - Basement and living spaces They’re designed for both indoor and outdoor environments. Travis Choate Project Coordinator Will the color look different in sunlight vs indoors? Yes, like natural stone, Desert Sunrise will appear slightly warmer and more vibrant in direct sunlight, while appearing more neutral indoors. The variation is subtle and adds to its realistic look. What do I need to complete a Desert Sunrise project? Most projects use a combination of: - Panels - Outside Corners - Leders All 14 Desert Sunrise components including the paint kit and caulking, work together to create a finished, seamless look. Ryan Walsh Project Coordinator Is Desert Sunrise difficult to install? No, GenStone panels are designed for easy installation using basic tools. Most customers follow a simple process: - Measure - Cut - Attach No masonry or carpentry experience is required. Zach Erhardt Manager Does Desert Sunrise work with other exterior colors? Yes, the warm tones pair well with: - White or cream trim - Earth-tone siding - Dark accents (black, bronze, charcoal) It’s a flexible color that complements many home styles. Avery Housley Project Coordinator Are the colors consistent between panels? Each panel includes natural color variation to mimic real stone, but all are manufactured to maintain a consistent overall look when installed together.
